title: Pies
label: XL Recordings
producers: Terror Danjah ('Take Chances', per a marketplace listing)

type.basis: Evidence specimen; its B-side is a vocal version of Terror Danjah's Creepy Crawler.

sound.text: A frenetic, scattering texture that PopMatters compares to a Japanese remix of Q-Bert sound effects (2004).
Complex mentions the album's 'pie-related hooks' among its non-sequitur lyrics.

context.text: Second single from Treddin' on Thin Ice (2004, per Wikipedia); a Wikipedia discography mirror gives a UK peak of 45 but leaves the year blank.

uncertainty: This entry is weak. The 12" format and B-side come only from an eBay listing, and the chart peak comes from a mirror that marks the year as inferred. Release date and catalogue number are unknown. Its B-side links to Terror Danjah, who is covered by another batch.
tracklist: A1: 'Pies' (vocal, from Treddin' on Thin Ice); B: 'Take Chances' (Wiley Kat, produced by Terror Danjah), according to an eBay listing that may not show the full tracklist.
